title: "Area 51" – map of California and Nevada with Groom Lake / Nevada Test Site inset
description: Map titled "Area 51" showing California, Nevada, Oregon and Arizona with marked locations including San Francisco, Edwards AFB, Burbank, Pasadena, Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas and Indian Springs, plus kilometer/mile scale bars. An inset map shows the "AEC Nevada Test Site," Yucca Lake, Frenchman Flat and the Mojave Desert, with "Area 51" and Groom Lake boxed at the northeast corner. Marked "Secret NOFORN" with a handwritten page number "58."
